observation.command:
cd /workspace/tests/data && python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/tmp/httpd2.log 2>&1 &
SRVPID=$!
sleep 2
cd /workspace && timeout 550 python3 -m poetry run python dcat_catalog_check.py --url http://localhost:8000/catalog.ttl --results /tmp/results.jsonl --recheck > /tmp/recheck.jsonl 2>/tmp/recheck_stderr.log
EC=$?
kill $SRVPID 2>/dev/null
echo "RECHECK_EXIT=$EC"
wc -l /tmp/recheck.jsonl
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
lines = open('/tmp/recheck.jsonl').read().splitlines()
valid = sum(1 for l in lines if json.loads(l))
print(f"valid JSON lines: {valid}/{len(lines)}")
# show sample record
print(json.dumps(json.loads(lines[0]), indent=2)[:600])
EOF
